title: Checkmate Basics
summary: Learn the difference between checkmate and stalemate, and how to spot when the game is truly over.
objectives: Recognize the difference in simple positions

steps.title: What is checkmate?
steps.body: Checkmate means the king is in check and there is no legal move to escape. The game ends immediately.

steps.title: What is stalemate?
steps.body: Stalemate means the player to move is not in check, but has no legal moves. The game is a draw.

steps.title: Checkmate example
steps.body: Black is in check from the queen and has no legal escape squares.

steps.title: Stalemate example
steps.body: Black is not in check, but every legal move is blocked. That makes it stalemate, not checkmate.

steps.title: Lesson recap
steps.body: Checkmate wins the game. Stalemate draws the game. Always ask: is the king actually in check?
